description: This file defines the LogNode interface used for logging, outlining a chainable logging system where each node can log messages and pass them along to the next node.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: A basic interface for a logging system that can output log messages to multiple targets and be chained with other log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
